# B.C. corporations update

_Category: Announcements · Source: BC Registries API community forum_

**maribeth.wilson** (3/10/2025):

In March, BC Registries will add additional common filings on the Business Registry to support new businesses.

Existing corporations created in Corporate Online will continue to use BC OnLine, Corporate Online and Search applications.

For more information, visit [bcreg.ca/corporations](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/employment-business/business/managing-a-business/permits-licences/news-updates/modernization-updates/setup-manage-corporation)

---

**trish.reimer** (3/11/2025):

As discussed in the last API user group meeting on Feb 19th:

- we heard that more time was needed for development 
- and ideally 2 months lead time before we go live. 
- so, in the meeting, we recommended that all API development be completed by mid-April so you are ready in time for the launch. 

 The actual launch date will be announced later, once we've completed testing with some early adopters in April. 

We will continue to keep you updated.

Thank you!
